(You do not need to enter your credit card number since you have a validation code).
When you're ready to go, request your vehicle via the text message you received, and your car will be retrieved.

When exiting, pull up to the gate and the gate will open after reading your registered license plate. If the gate does not open, please scan the QR code at the exit lane, and send the pre-filled text message to exit.
